items.q: How do I count how many times a link was clicked for free?
items.a: Link Charts shows the total click count for each link on the real-time analytics dashboard. Access the free dashboard to see the click counter, geographic distribution, and device breakdown — at no cost.

items.q: How do I shorten a link for WhatsApp?
items.a: Paste the long URL into the shortener field and click Shorten. The generated short link works directly on WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and any messaging app, without creating an account.

items.q: Is there a free link shortener without registration?
items.a: Yes. Link Charts lets you shorten links for free without creating an account. To save your links and access detailed analytics for each one, just create a free account.

items.q: What is the best free alternative to Bitly?
items.a: It depends on what you need. Link Charts focuses on advanced free analytics: geographic tracking by country and city, device and browser breakdown, UTM campaign tracking, custom subdomain, and QR Code — features that require a paid plan on Bitly.

items.q: How do I create a click counter for my links?
items.a: When you shorten a link with Link Charts, a click counter is created automatically. You can track total clicks, geographic origin, device types, and peak hours in real time on the dashboard.

items.q: How can I see which country my link clicks came from?
items.a: The analytics for each link in Link Charts includes a geographic heatmap with breakdown by country, state, and city. Open the Geographic tab in the link dashboard to see where your visitors came from.

items.q: Can I get a free custom subdomain for my links?
items.a: Yes. By creating a free Link Charts account, you can set a custom subdomain — for example, yourbrand.linkcharts.com.br — for all your shortened links, at no extra cost.

items.q: How do I track UTM parameters on shortened links?
items.a: Link Charts automatically detects and records UTM parameters — source, medium, campaign, term, and content — for each click received. Campaign data appears in the Insights tab of the dashboard in real time.

items.q: How do I generate a free QR code for a link?
items.a: Every shortened link in Link Charts automatically generates a free high-resolution QR code. You can download it directly from the dashboard in the QR Code tab, ready for print or digital materials.

items.q: Do shortened links work on WhatsApp and Instagram?
items.a: Yes. Links shortened with Link Charts work on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Twitter/X, and all messaging apps and social networks. The link redirects the visitor to the destination and tracks the click automatically.

items.q: How long do shortened links stay active?
items.a: Shortened links stay active indefinitely. You can also set an expiration date or a click limit so the link deactivates automatically once the defined criterion is reached.

items.q: Can I view link analytics without logging in?
items.a: Yes. Each shortened link has a public analytics page accessible without login. Share the analytics link so anyone can follow the click data, country of origin, and device breakdown in real time.
